title: Instancing planes example
summary: Adds new instancing-planes example rendering a large batch of small planes via one instanced draw call. Each instance has random position, size, and color, with OrbitalControl and AxisHelper. Includes camera-facing billboarding using cameraRight/cameraUp packed by Camera.writeUniformData().
handoff_message: Antigravity review complete for "instancing-planes". In Cursor, ask the agent to use get_feedback_for_cursor for "instancing-planes".
